title: Validation finding
description: Fragment: one finding of a validation report (design decision ADR-016).

finding.title: Finding
finding.description: One rule violation or observation reported by a validation report. Findings are sorted by 'ruleId', 'code', the first 'elementRefs' entry, the whole 'elementRefs' list, 'subjectRef.id', 'instancePath', 'message' and finally the canonical form of the finding without 'findingId'; 'findingId' is 'f-<1-based index>' in that order. Findings with visibility 'restricted' MUST NOT include raw personal measurements in 'message'; protected detail goes only into 'evidence'.

findingId.description: ID of the finding within its report: 'f-<1-based index>' in finding order.

ruleVersion.description: Version of the rule that produced the finding.

code.description: Diagnostic code of the condition found.

severity.description: Severity of the finding: the severity of its rule in the applied profile.

message.description: Human-readable description of the finding. It MUST NOT contain raw personal measurement values.

elementRefs.description: Elements the finding is about; each points into a revision listed in the report's 'targetRefs'. May be empty, and is sorted by artifactId, revisionId, elementId.

subjectRef.description: Derived document the finding is about; one of the report's 'derivedSubjectRefs'.

instancePath.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the subject document.

visibility.description: Who may see the finding's detail.

evidence.description: Open supporting data. A finding whose evidence contains protected data has visibility 'restricted'.

findingVisibility.title: Finding visibility
findingVisibility.description: 'general': visible to everyone who may read the report; 'restricted': contains or relates to protected data and is shown only to authorized readers.
